classified.method: PretrainedSED Frame-MN10 strong singing events with confidence-gated phrasing

timing.alignment: 40 ms sound-event evidence with estimated phrase edges and accents; no separated vocal stem or word alignment

diagnostics.confidenceMeaning: Relative evidence score; not a calibrated probability

vocals.method: GAME Large neural sung-note boundaries and pitches, with separated-source expression and singing/speech evidence

timing.alignment: Neural note boundaries on the source PCM clock, gated by separated voice evidence; no word alignment

diagnostics.limitations: Separation bleed, layered voices, distortion, unvoiced consonants and rapid pitch changes can remain ambiguous. Pitch follows a dominant periodic voice, not every harmony. Articulation markers are not transcribed words.
diagnostics.confidenceMeaning: Containing voice phrase evidence, not a calibrated GAME note probability
